WITH event_budgets AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_event,
    CASE 
      WHEN SUM(amount) IS NULL OR SUM(amount) = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE SUM(spent) / SUM(amount)
    END as spend_ratio
  FROM budget
  WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY link_to_event
),
avg_ratio AS (
  SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) as average_spend_ratio
  FROM event_budgets
)
SELECT 
  eb.link_to_event as event_id,
  eb.spend_ratio,
  eb.spend_ratio / ar.average_spend_ratio as relative_ratio
FROM event_budgets eb
CROSS JOIN avg_ratio ar
ORDER BY 
  relative_ratio IS NULL,
  relative_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
